نتراكض (form VI)
# نَتَرَاكَضُ (natarākaḍu) /na.ta.raː.ka.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاكَضَ (tarākaḍa)
# نَتَرَاكَضَ (natarākaḍa) /na.ta.raː.ka.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاكَضَ (tarākaḍa)
# نَتَرَاكَضْ (natarākaḍ) /na.ta.raː.kadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاكَضَ (tarākaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
